**Answer**

- **How the value is supplied at assembly:** The distribution passes `--application-version <version>` to `openmrs assemble`. The CLI option is defined in `openmrs-esm-core/packages/tooling/openmrs/src/cli.ts` (lines 345-350). `assemble.ts` writes it as the top-level `version` of `routes.registry.json` (lines 392-401), and only when it is non-empty.
- **Runtime path:** `run.ts` reads `initialRouteMap.version` and defines `window.applicationVersion` (lines 104-124). A value of `prerelease` is replaced by the "Prerelease" translation, or "local" when `spaVersion` is `local`.
- **Where it shows by default:** The sign-in page renders `window.applicationVersion` below the form (`openmrs-esm-core/packages/apps/esm-login-app/src/login/login.component.tsx`, line 258). The primary navbar also renders it (`navbar.component.tsx`, line 65).
- **When nobody sets it:** The flag defaults to `undefined`, so the registry omits `version`. `run.ts` then defines `applicationVersion` as `undefined`, and the sign-in page renders nothing. The value is not shown.
- **Change that added it:** Commit `9f0c6aa831f37ffcaf167a7096b07ec3e96a0431`, "(feat) Add a distribution-controlled version property (#1815)", by Ian, 2026-08-21. The diff adds the sign-in line in `login.component.tsx`.
- **Ticket:** I could not find one. The commit title and body carry only PR #1815 and a co-author line, and no changeset or doc names an O3 ticket for it. The ticket is probably in the PR description on GitHub, which these tools cannot read. Checking that is the way to settle it.

Falkon's repo lookup needed the full `github.com/openmrs/<name>` form; the bare names failed. I did not modify any files. One `get_diff` output was too large to read, and the tool-result file was not readable here, so I relied on path-filtered diffs.
